card.name: Comma after Severe in NSAID warnings
card.fires_on: The comma right after "Severe" in the NSAID contraindication line "Severe, sometimes fatal, anaphylactic reactions". It also fires on the first piece of a brand name such as AIR in AIRSUPRA or BAL in BALVERSA.
